I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and the 1280px rendering are unchecked.

It has the "Team" heading, an ink "Invite Member" button, and the five members. Each member has a name, an email and a role select (Admin, Editor, Viewer) set to the role you gave. It follows `DESIGN.md` and uses the values from `tokens.css`, which I copied into the file so it stands alone. It's static HTML and CSS only, inside `id="component"` at 1280px.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so the browser will show its system sans-serif instead.
- **Column headers:** I added "Name", "Email" and "Role" in the label style, because the design file asks for a header row on lists. That goes slightly beyond your exact content. Delete the `<thead>` if you don't want it.
- **Select arrow:** the selects keep the browser's native arrow, since the design file doesn't give an arrow colour.
